scope: A complete scan of the in-source copyright and attribution lines of every included cargo and npm component of the Windows, macOS and Android selections, compared with the texts each component delivers; which lines are delivered additionally. Not final application compliance or installer delivery.
method: Sources: the registry sources of the locked archives (vendor/russh for russh, node_modules for npm), 405 components; .rs, C, assembly, JS and CSS files outside tests, benches, examples and build.rs.

A hit is a comment line with "Copyright", "(c) <year>" or "©" that is not license boilerplate. Its holder (the line without years and markers) counts as covered when the component's delivered texts contain it or all its significant words.
67 components had 549 uncovered lines; each was read in its file and decided by the rules below.
rules: Delivered: the file is compiled into a shipped binary, the component's license asks to keep the notice in copies or binary form (MIT, BSD, W3C), and the line names a holder of adapted third-party code, or the crate's only copyright notice, that no delivered text names.
Not delivered: the holder is already named in the delivered texts, or the line names the crate's own authors while the delivered texts carry the crate's copyright notice.

Not delivered: the selected license is Apache-2.0, which keeps in-source copyright notices in the Source form only, unless the file embeds code under another license that asks for its notice (tao's W3C part).
Not delivered: the file is not compiled for Windows, macOS or Android, the component is a build tool or proc macro on every platform, or the hit is a false positive.

outside_the_scan: Rust standard library (rust-1.97.1 texts), Android NDK (complete NOTICE files) and Maven libraries of the APK (binary archives; their own texts are selected from the archives).
decision: Each shipped package keeps its selected license and texts and additionally delivers the quoted blocks verbatim in <package>-<version>-SOURCE-NOTICES.txt, in every selection that includes it (pattern: crypto-bigint, futures-channel, crypto-primes). With this scan the open item of docs/stand.md point 6 is closed; a version change of one of these packages is caught by release-license-update-cargo.mjs as a text from outside the crate.
